Cameras digitized vision. Microphones digitized sound. Smell is the one major sense we still can't capture, measure or transmit reliably. Cellsor is building the sensor that changes that.

About the Venture

AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up.

Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around.

Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task.

Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permane

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Wir bauen gerade an mehreren Dingen gleichzeitig: einem neuen Produkt für gewerbliche Versender, Piloten mit großen Marken, neuen Strecken, Integrationen. An jedem dieser Themen arbeiten mehrere Menschen aus mehreren Bereichen, und keiner von ihnen hat den vollen Überblick über alle anderen.

Genau dafür gibt es diese Stelle. Du weißt zu jeder Zeit, wo jedes Projekt steht, was als Nächstes ansteht und wo es gerade klemmt. Eine Frage zum aktuellen Sprint, und du kannst sie beantworten. Eine Frage zu einem Partnerprojekt, und du gehst auf die Leute zu und sorgst dafür, dass am Tag X alles steht.

Du bist kein Product Owner und musst nicht entwickeln können. Du musst verstehen, worum es geht, grob einschätzen können, was etwas bedeutet, und Dinge über die Ziellinie bringen.

Hierfür suchen wir dich ab dem 15.11.2026 als Verstärkung für unser Team in Köln 🚀

jobs.title: Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
termios builds smart thermostats for real estate. Our product — termios Pro — replaces standard radiator thermostats in existing buildings, performs hydraulic balancing via a self-learning algorithm, and cuts heating energy consumption by up to 30%. No battery, no retrofitting: the device harvests energy from the temperature differential between radiator and room air (thermo-harvesting) and communicates over LoRaWAN.

The system runs at scale across multi-unit residential portfolios. Each thermostat is a constrained embedded device operating autonomously, syncing state through a LoRaWAN gateway to a cloud backend that runs the optimization logic. We're 35 people, growing, and the firmware team is small — your work ships directly to devices in real apartments.

Tasks

The firmware running on our smart thermostats — from first commit to field rollout. You write code, solder, measure, debug. No handoffs to someone else when it gets hard.

  • Thermostat firmware development and optimization

  • LoRaWAN communication stack (implementation + maintenance)

  • Low-power / energy harvesting optimization

  • OTA update mechanisms
